name: ppt-visual-reconstructor
description: Create a high-fidelity editable PowerPoint slide from one reference image with callable local reconstruction tools.

interface.shortDescription: Turn one slide image into a high-fidelity editable PPTX.
interface.longDescription: Accepts a single reference PNG or JPEG, decomposes it into native PowerPoint text and shapes plus protected image regions, creates a semantic SVG intermediate, calls a local Windows PowerPoint toolchain, and iteratively corrects the slide toward at least 90% pixel similarity.
defaultPrompt: Use only this reference image to create an editable PowerPoint slide with at least 90% pixel similarity.
Repair this SVG-to-PowerPoint conversion and preserve selected images.
Compare this PPTX render with the reference and produce a correction plan.
